1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Review low-carbon, waste-heat-based utilization of BFS and steel slag (glass-ceramics, ceramics, mineral wool, cementitious materials, adsorbents) and their CO2 sequestration.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Molten slag latent heat (~1400 MJ/t for SS) enables online modification. SS cementitious use limited by poor hydration activity and f-CaO/f-MgO instability; online reconstruction with CaF2, fly ash, SiO2, lime or BFS reduces f-CaO. Direct gas-solid SS carbonation rate rose 70-fold from 400 to 600 °C; grinding with alumina beads raised carbonation to 78%. 4.7 t converter slag binds 1 t CO2 (indirect).
